target_customer: Real estate agents who share buyer and seller intent, with buyers and homeowners as free users
problem: Most homes are not listed on the market, so buyers lack inventory and homeowners cannot get private offers.
business_model: Agent-to-agent network; free for buyers, referral commission from agents (per one profile site)

founders.name: Tim Hyer
previous_startups: A previous startup that raised over $10M (name not given on the YC page)

founders.name: Nicholas Meyers
founders.background_notes: YC page says software engineer with 20+ years of experience.

technical_complexity.rationale: A matching network and data lookup using property data is standard web engineering; the difficulty is onboarding agents.

defensibility.rationale: Agent network density could create a moat, but there is no evidence of scale beyond one profile claim of about 350 agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes an incumbent response; other off-market startups such as Unlisted appear in later search results.

market_need_then: The thesis is that much inventory is off market. No dated demand evidence was found beyond company descriptions.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain real estate language: limitless real estate

brand_strength.rationale: The word conveys trust, which fits agent matchmaking, but trademark records show a TRUSTY mark owned by a Timothy Hyer from 2019 and 2020 filings, and many other companies use the word.

pivots.from: Consumer reviews app for homes (2021 per one profile site)

outcome_analysis: Trusty is listed as active with a team of 6 and its site could not be read. A secondary profile claims about 350 agents and $1.6M raised, but neither is confirmed by a primary source, and no news of an exit or shutdown exists. The story is too thin to assign factors.
notes: Funding is unverified: one profile reports $1.6M from two leads and four angels, another cites a $130K seed; both secondary, so no round recorded. The trustyhomes.com fetch returned empty content. No dated competitor sources were found; the ATTOM Data article about Trusty was not opened. The pivot comes from a single profile snippet.
